title: Storybound Codex entry
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/codex/<path>.json — an entry made of sections the player uncovers one by one.

category.description: Group in the Codex tab; a missing namespace means storybound. Name: <ns>.codex.category.<path>. Built in: monsters, animals, characters, places, lore.

entity.description: What seen and killed refer to: an id, a #tag or a list. A single id also gives the portrait.

text.description: A long text, assets/<ns>/storybound/texts/<lang>/<path>.sbt. Default: <ns>:codex/<entry path>/<section id>.

notify.description: Toasts when the entry appears or a section opens.

unlock.description: Any source reaching count (sightings or kills; a read counts once) opens the section, if the conditions hold then.
